achievements: AWS SDK v3 migration: Completed update to Authentication.mjs for modern AWS SDK
Frontend configuration hardening: Improved config.js with endpoint management
Proxy Lambda security: API key injection mechanism prevents browser exposure
SNS alert integration: Full subscription flow with cooldown logic to prevent notification fatigue
Multi-user isolation: DynamoDB itemization by userID with proper scoping
Category management: Full CRUD with safe deletion (reassign to 'Uncategorized')
OpenWolf integration: Implemented context management protocol for consistent session handling

improvements.title: Add test suite
improvements.description: No automated tests exist. Create pytest for Python Lambdas and Jest for Node.js
improvements.impact: High - catches regressions, enables safe refactoring

improvements.title: Implement request validation schemas
improvements.description: Add JSON schema validation in each Lambda to validate userID, itemID, and required fields before processing
improvements.impact: Medium - prevents malformed requests from corrupting data

improvements.title: Add session token expiration
improvements.description: Current tokens in sessionStorage have no expiration. Add server-side TTL validation or client-side 24h refresh

improvements.title: Comprehensive error logging
improvements.description: Add CloudWatch/X-Ray instrumentation to all Lambdas for debugging production issues

improvements.title: Rate limiting on Lambda side
improvements.description: Implement per-userID request rate limiting in Proxy.py or API Gateway throttling
improvements.impact: Medium - prevents abuse and quota exhaustion

improvements.title: Environment variable validation
improvements.description: Add startup checks in each Lambda to ensure required env vars (DYNAMODB_TABLE, SNS_TOPIC_ARN, etc.) are set
improvements.impact: Low - prevents silent failures on misconfiguration

next_tasks.task: Verify AWS SDK v3 migration in staging
next_tasks.description: Test Authentication.mjs login/register flow end-to-end; ensure SNS subscription still works
Examine spec.md and eval-rubric.md; identify any hardening gaps exposed by the evaluation
Set up pytest for Python (AddItem, UpdateItem, DeleteItem, etc.) and Jest for Authentication.mjs
Add schema validation for userID, itemID, category name in all inventory Lambdas
Log all API calls, errors, and transaction completions to CloudWatch for debugging
Create OpenAPI/Swagger spec for all Lambda endpoints with request/response schemas

risks.title: No request validation at Lambda boundary
risks.description: Lambdas assume client sends valid userID, itemID, and payload structure. Malformed requests could cause DynamoDB errors.
risks.mitigation: Add JSON schema validation as first step in each handler

risks.title: Session tokens have no expiration
risks.description: sessionStorage tokens valid indefinitely; stolen token = permanent access until browser clear
risks.mitigation: Implement 24h client-side rotation or add server-side TTL check in Proxy.py

risks.title: Userdata not validated server-side
risks.description: CLAUDE.md notes: 'userID is trusted from the client request body (no server-side ownership check on writes)'
risks.mitigation: Extract userID from x-api-key context or JWT instead of trusting client

risks.title: No test suite
risks.description: Manual QA only; refactoring or dependency upgrades risk silent data corruption
risks.mitigation: Implement pytest + Jest suite covering all CRUD paths and edge cases

risks.title: Limited production observability
risks.description: No CloudWatch logs or X-Ray tracing; debugging production issues requires AWS console digging
risks.mitigation: Add structured logging to all Lambdas; enable X-Ray sampling

risks.title: Proxy.py OPTIONS preflight inline handling
risks.description: CORS preflight handled in Proxy.py; may miss future CORS issues if API Gateway config drifts
risks.mitigation: Move CORS to API Gateway level or centralize in Proxy with clearer docs

risks.title: DynamoDB pagination not tested at scale
risks.description: GetAllItems.py handles 1MB pagination; untested with large inventories (>10k items)
risks.mitigation: Add integration tests with synthetic data at scale
